title: omx-contract domain document
description: A domain document (docs/contract-dir.md, Domains): <contractdir>/<domain>/<last segment>.json, one JSON Schema 2020-12 document of a vocabulary, its words items under components.schemas. GPL-3.0-or-later. What a schema cannot say stays in the reader (src/lib/domain.mts): the prefix rule (an item name starts with the domain's name in upper snake case with its underscore, and never with the prefix of a longer domain of the read); the x-code order (a word's x-code is its place in the oneOf, from 0); a title used twice in one item; x-groups naming a words item of this document and x-group a word of that item; the $id agreeing with the directory the document is in (the domain's name, a nested domain's document being <domain>/<last segment>.json); a name used by two domains; and x-since and x-why, which the reader does not type.

$id.description: The stable id of the domain, the URL every cross-domain reference names.

x-owner.description: The package that owns the domain today: metadata, never a path.

x-stability.description: The domain's stability level: every document carries it, and there is no default.

schemas.description: The items of the domain, each named in upper snake case.

words.description: A words item: its description the item's doc, a oneOf of one word each in their declared order.

x-groups.description: The name of the words item of this document whose words are the groups of this item's words.

x-c-codes.description: The item becomes constants, its codes header.

x-c-xmacro.description: The item's codes header also carries an X-macro; only with x-c-codes true.

const.description: The word as written: any string.

title.description: The word's key, the name of its macro.

x-code.description: The word's code, its place in the order.

x-text.description: The English source sentence the catalogs translate.

x-group.description: A word of the item x-groups names.
